meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一句文字描述变成照片、插画或 logo,也能改图换背景。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要给文章、产品或社媒配图,却不会自己画。
copy.tagline_en: Turn prompts into photos, illustrations, or logos, and edit existing images.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick visuals for posts, products, or social media without design skills.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会运行脚本调用 OpenRouter 的图像模型，按你的文字描述生成图片，或用参考图做编辑，输出保存为本地 PNG 文件。使用前需配置 OpenRouter API key。
howto.when: 当你要生成照片、插画、概念图等通用图片，或想修改、合成已有图片时触发。流程图、电路图等技术图表改用 scientific-schematics。

say.text: 帮我生成一张山间日落的照片，保存成 sunset.png
say.note: 脚本调用图像模型生成并保存为 PNG

say.text: 把 photo.jpg 里的天空改成紫色
say.note: 带上输入图即进入编辑模式

say.text: 用 flux.2-pro 模型生成一张太空里的猫

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude runs a script that calls OpenRouter image models to generate an image from your text prompt or edit one from a reference image, saving the result as a local PNG file. An OpenRouter API key is required.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a photo, illustration or other general image, or want to edit an existing one. For flowcharts, circuits and technical diagrams, use scientific-schematics instead.

say_en.text: Generate a photo of a sunset over mountains, save it as sunset.png
say_en.note: Runs the script and saves a PNG

say_en.text: Change the sky in photo.jpg to purple
say_en.note: Passing an input image enables edit mode

say_en.text: Generate a cat in space using flux.2-pro
